scope: Two prescribed-field early-body research hypotheses, mixed results and no production promotion. Loss, geometry/source coupling and level matching prevent source-only identification; no attack/repick/fret/upper-sustain/CPU/aliasing qualification.

protocol_instantaneous.scope: Research only: test the direction of a physical static-force initial field through the existing magnetic/electrical/output path. No production candidate or attack, repick, fret-change, upper-sustain or authenticity qualification.
protocol_instantaneous.A: Unchanged shipping engine. The diagnostic hook pass-through must be bit-identical to separately linked unmodified production Source for every fixture.

B.initial_condition: Simply supported stiff-string static equilibrium under a point force; q_n=F*sin(n*pi*p)/(mu*L/2*omega_n^2), v_n=0. F=existing4.8N*voice.velocityProfile.amplitude*voice.strokeForceGain; no force/gain search.
B.PDE: mu*y_tt=T*y_xx-EI*y_xxxx, EI=T*L^2*B/pi^2. T,mu,L and existing empirical B read from the same production voice at contact. B is NOT a measured EI.
B.frequency: omega_n^2=(T/mu)*(n*pi/L)^2*(1+B*n^2). Preserve material T/mu rather than silently pin the small stiffness-shifted fundamental.
B.truncation: Every mode below internal Nyquist. Finite modal projection has the v8 pre-front limitations; this diagnostic does not qualify an attack or contact mobility.
B.hold_release: Initial field held through the actual production Contact clock, then free cosine evolution without a state edit. Prime production previousFlux only when introducing the explicitly held static state. No pickup signal is reset at release.
B.pickup: At common physical time integrate each sine mode over the existing4.8mm rectangular coil aperture. Coil centers at existing anchor plus/minus existing spacing/2; far coil weight1 and near coil existing voiced balance0.6, normalized by1.6. Single coil uses its existing anchor and zero spacing. Polarization factor=0.85*verticalWeight+0.35*horizontalWeight. Convert SI displacement by existing0.040m/unit. This replaces spatial decoding as part of the physical-string hypothesis, not a claim of identical old spatial math.
B.downstream: Verified hook after old coil/aperture and before original magnetic transfer, Faraday difference, EMF lowpass, loaded-coil circuit, selector, output and decimator. No duplicate output chain or extra EQ/filter/gain.
B.loss: Explicitly lossless. Do not attribute every A/B difference to initial source alone. Primary scope early H1-H3 shape, not late or upper-band decay. Existing pole-decay bounds will be recorded separately.
B.other_limitations: Original engine drives scheduler, pitch metadata, articulation and retirement; clean body/noise/artifact/sympathy disabled equally. B lacks the production attack glide, anisotropy, body and loss. It is a diagnostic of the model direction, not a coherent complete replacement instrument. Static preload is an initial condition, not a simulated or measured pick trajectory.

references.selection: First ordinary open-E2 event in each frozen day1 player score, before computing B. Original first2s crop and original windows retained; no alignment or inferred NoteOff. The source may have prior activity and is not asserted to be a known zero-state release.
references.hardware: P1 Strat and P2 Les Paul, six-string. Exact pickup, force, hand position and electronics unknown. All four fixed model profiles shown; no best profile per source/window and no default inferred.

analysis.primary: Existing observer unchanged; original centered128ms windows at0.1,0.2,0.35s after the first measured onset, source hold censoring retained. Report every H1 share/H2-H1/H3-H1 signed and absolute error, no composite fidelity score or tuned acceptance threshold.
analysis.secondary: All eight original first-note windows through1.75s shown descriptively, with explicit lossless/no-attack limitation. Full thirty-note frozen source distributions provide context only, not simulated repick validation.
analysis.level: One whole2s-file RMS trim to-24dBFS per letter/reference, one common peak headroom, no window gain/EQ/timewarp. Keep raw physical levels and exact gains; primary harmonic ratios are gain-independent.
analysis.numerics: Independent direct sine/modal checks of generated taps, finite equilibrium/storage/initial velocity and exact spatial aperture. Rerun a fixed192k-internal field at the same96k sample times for primary low-partial convergence before claiming a stable tone direction. No thresholds or masks modified after results.
analysis.standing_user_choice: Autonomous candidate direction; no listener vote invented. Regardless of direction, this research does not satisfy production green gates.

protocol_finite_unloading.scope: Separate prospective mechanical-release hypothesis after the instantaneous-static-release diagnostic, using the same source/reference/crops/controls and original primary windows. No production qualification.
protocol_finite_unloading.mechanism: Replace instantaneous removal of the held static force with monotonic finite force unloading. The release-rate kernel uses the existing C2 pulse duration/load/slip shape and the existing one-pole string-release coefficient, normalized by its discrete area. Do NOT include the Bessel modal projection: the explicit static modal field supplies the spatial1/n^2 stiffness-dependent coefficients it approximates. This choice follows the existing source's declared separation of modal projection and slip release, not a fitted curve.
protocol_finite_unloading.force: For nonnegative release weights r_j summing to1, held force F_i=F0*(1-sum_{j<=i}r_j). Field q_n(i)=q_static_n*[1-sum_{j<=i}r_j+sum_{j<=i}r_j*cos(omega_n*(i-j)*h)]. This is exact superposition under interval-constant force on the same finite modal string. q/v continuous at each force change. Same F0 and initial held field as B; no fitted force or magnitude normalization at H1.
protocol_finite_unloading.implementation: Compute the exact same scalar spatial pickup field by convolving (B_free_tap-held_tap) with r and adding held_tap. This commutes only because this declared string and spatial observation are linear. It occurs before unchanged nonlinear magnetics/Faraday/electrical/output; it is NOT post-output EQ. Prove equivalence against independently stepped constant-force modal flow before reporting tone.
protocol_finite_unloading.timing: Start force unloading at the actual frozen A Release index. Preserve native contact latency, held-field flux prime and no release flux reset. No A/reference alignment or window gain.
protocol_finite_unloading.parameters: Read actual release-length, excitationLoadScale, excitationSlipScale and excitationReleaseCoefficient from the same shipping A voice at Contact in a separate metadata-only pass. Every such pass must be byte-identical to original frozen A PCM. No numbers drawn from the dry recordings or auditory preference.
protocol_finite_unloading.limits: The inherited pulse/slip coordinates remain voiced, not a measured plectrum trajectory or geometric release law. This models a prescribed unloading force, not passive plectrum contact, compression-only detach, damping, repicking or moving frets. Same lossless/fixed stiffness/polarization/finite-mode/pre-front limits as B. No natural-attack claim from q/v continuity alone.
protocol_finite_unloading.comparison: A shipping remains untouched; D finite-unloading study uses the same four fixed profiles, all16 original first-note windows and early0.1/0.2/0.35s primary scope, same one whole2s RMS trim and common headroom. Record B instantaneous as previous evidence. No best profile, threshold relaxation, default selection or95percent score.
protocol_finite_unloading.standing_choice: Autonomous candidate investigation. Measurements can reject it regardless of the standing candidate preference; no listener vote is claimed.

terminology_correction.correction: The inherited pulse is a product of clamped cubic smoothStep load/slip factors. Its continuous extension is C1, not C2; second derivatives generally jump at support endpoints and the asymmetric peak. The physical force used by this exact discrete model is interval-constant and changes between intervals. Continuity of q and v comes from the exact forced harmonic flow, not C2 smoothness of the pulse or force.
terminology_correction.evidence: Source/DSP/DspMath.h smoothStep and ElectryEngine.cpp ordinary Release pulse; independent final_review finding.
terminology_correction.effect: Terminology only. Frozen protocol, generated release weights, fields, PCM, numeric analyses and thresholds are unchanged. Public reporting must use cubic load/slip pulse and must not claim an artifact-free attack.
